notes: Text styles: seven one-tap presets including red tag, white tag, gold gradient, black outline, neon glow, sale tag and elegant thin.
Text background: adjustable opacity, and a new price-tag shape with a pointed end.
Text shadow can now be positioned and blurred with three sliders.
Outline colour and width are always available instead of only with the outline style.
New Title + subtitle button creates a matched main title and smaller subtitle in one tap.
